scope: Smaller game.zip by user decision: the stage font becomes the static Regular instance without Hanja, and the progressive-image placeholders become 64-colour PNGs. Measurement, build, local checks, deployment and live checks. Not a release judgement, a physical device test or a screen reader test.
userDecision: After the byte measurement (checkpoint.json, byteCandidates): '글꼴 변경 좋다. 그리고 한자는 우리 쓸 일이 없어. 미리보기 색 줄이기 좋아.' Kana were not mentioned and stay.

provenance.localOnly: Candidates .cache/pages-release-20261031e (before) and .cache/pages-release-20261101a (after), and the raw screenshots in .cache/font-compare, exist only on this machine. stage-font-punctuation.png and stage-font-hanja.png in this folder are Git-ignored by repository policy (screen evidence stays local); rerun measurement/stage-font-compare.mjs to regenerate them.

changes.stageFont: spikes/renpy-web/stage_font.py, called by spikes/renpy-web/build.py instead of copying the upstream font. fontTools 4.60.2 instancer at wght 400 (Ren'Py draws a variable font with its 'regular' instance when no instance is set, SDK doc/text.html; the presenter sets no instance, axis or bold), then a subset without CJK ideographs, Extension A/B and later, compatibility ideographs, CJK radicals, Kangxi radicals and ideographic description characters. Keeps all layout features, names, hinting tables and .notdef. Version and unique ID name records say it is a modified stage font; no name uses the Reserved Font Name 'Source'. Self-checks: no fvar or gvar, exactly the expected characters, OS/2 weight 400. build.py stops unless the output SHA-256 is f934737fbbde38eebe52d002c8fd898e830bfba1778676e38c3b0c4283fa94c9 (deterministic: two runs gave the same bytes).
changes.placeholders: spikes/renpy-web/placeholders.py, run by build.py right after the SDK web build and before the transport copies, transfer sizes and content versions. Every _placeholders/ entry is decoded, quantized to 64 colours (Pillow 11.3.0 FASTOCTREE) and saved as a palette PNG; fully transparent pixels stay fully transparent and fully opaque pixels stay opaque. A placeholder that is not a PNG stops the build. Other entries keep their bytes, order, dates and attributes; deflated entries are compressed again at level 9.
changes.tests: scripts/tests/test_runtime_stage_font.py (synthetic variable font: static, outline and advance at wght 400, Hanja ranges, names, deterministic output, a static source refused) and scripts/tests/test_runtime_placeholders.py (synthetic archive: palette PNG, at most 64 colours, exact full transparency and opacity, other entries unchanged, a non-PNG placeholder stops and keeps the archive). CI installs fonttools==4.60.2 next to Pillow==11.3.0.
changes.docs: spikes/renpy-web/README.md, docs/architecture/reproducible-test-environment.md (runtime:build needs fonttools 4.60.2 and Pillow 11.3.0), DESIGN.md 무대 글꼴 — 2026-11-01 사용자 결정.

stageFontComparison.method: measurement/stage-font-compare.mjs: the runtime page of each candidate (before on port 3150, after on 3151, scripts/serve-static-candidate.py) loaded alone in an iframe and driven with the same RuntimeScene messages: 10 texts (short, sentences, numbers and Latin, punctuation and symbols, paragraphs, four pages of long text, old Hangul jamo and kana, emoji with a combining accent, Hanja, choices) at 390x844 (720x1558 logical, font 32) and 1280x720 (font 30). Every page screenshotted and compared.
stageFontComparison.result: 20 of 20 cases: the same page boundaries (dialoguePage index, count and offsets) and the same text box, dialogue and choice rectangles. Pixels differ only at glyph edges: for example desktop long text 7,553 changed pixels per page, 187 by more than 64 of 255; stage-font-punctuation.png shows before, after and the amplified difference. The Hanja case draws a box for each Hanja (stage-font-hanja.png), as decided.

The steps before line 72 (connection, revisions 0-41, the same frame, alignment through resize) ran.
